name: chat_send
description: Send a text message to a clanker chatroom. For a direct message to another instance, use chat_dm. The message is logged locally and delivered to every peer clanker subscribed to that room (POST /api/chat/message). Returns the message ts and id.
llm_description: Send a text message to a chatroom. Input: {room, text (max 4096 chars)}. Returns message ts and id. Direct messages: chat_dm {to, text}.

to.description: Direct-message recipient. Use this instead of room; the host creates a canonical dm room.
